title: Quick movement breaks for a wiggly body
group: LDS-FOCUS — Focus and Getting Things Done
examples: What can I do when I feel wiggly?
I cannot sit still in class

steps.label: Stretch up tall
steps.note: Reach for the sky. Count to five.

steps.label: Ten jumps
steps.note: Jump on the spot, ten times.

steps.label: Wall push
steps.note: Push the wall hard, then let go.
steps.ask: What if I cannot leave my seat?

steps.label: Shake it out
steps.note: Shake your hands and feet.

steps.label: Drink of water
steps.note: Sip, breathe, and back you go.
steps.ask: How do I ask for a movement break?

explain.say: Does your body ever feel fizzy, like it wants to move and move? That is your body asking for a movement break. Look at the board. Here are five quick moves, one at a time.

faq.a: Moving gets your blood flowing and wakes up your brain. After a short move, many people find it easier to sit and focus.
asks: Tell me about Stretch up tall

faq.q: What if I cannot leave my seat?
faq.a: Try seat moves. Press your hands together hard, push your feet into the floor, or roll your shoulders. Nobody needs to notice.

faq.q: How do I ask for a movement break?
faq.a: You can say, Can I have a movement break, please? Some schools use a break card you can show instead.
asks: Tell me about Drink of water

faq.q: How long is a movement break?
faq.a: Short. One to three minutes is usually enough. Then you go back to your work.

faq.q: Is it okay to need lots of breaks?
faq.a: Yes. Every body is different. A grown-up you trust can help you plan when your breaks happen.

facts: Short bursts of movement are used by many schools as brain breaks.
Pushing or pulling heavy things gives the muscles strong input, which many people find calming.

options.show: Can I have a movement break, please?
options.say: Can I have a movement break, please?

quiz.why: Asking for a movement break tells your teacher what your body needs.

wrong.1: Your teacher can help when you ask.
wrong.2: Running off can be unsafe. Asking first is better.

quiz.say: Which move can you do while sitting?
quiz.why: You can push your feet into the floor without leaving your seat.

wrong.1: Jumps need you to stand up.
wrong.2: A lap needs you to leave your seat.
